headline: Shaping Steel
p1: After a successful business career (and never using my hands except to type on a keyboard), I'm now enjoying retirement as an amateur metal sculptor. I love the spark, grind, and weld of turning raw steel into art—especially the design and hands-on fabrication process.
p2: Working from my studio/workshop, I combine traditional metalworking techniques with contemporary design to create pieces that live at the intersection of craft and fine art.
p3: All sculptures are fabricated with either Mild and or Stainless Steel.
